01 / CONTRIBUTION

Flutter product design, implementation & backend engineering

Designed and developed the Flutter messaging journey and separately built documented NestJS REST foundations; real iOS simulator imagery shows a recent local build, while custom Flutter–backend integration remains pending.

  • Created a cohesive Mingle visual experience with registration, profiles, conversations, discovery and thoughtful empty states.
  • Provided actual iPhone simulator screenshots and two running-app recordings for an honest product walkthrough.
  • Organized Flutter auth/chat into feature-first architecture with repository contracts and Cubit state management.
  • Implemented NestJS/PostgreSQL authentication, user discovery, direct conversations, durable messages and read/edit/delete REST flows.
Scope & status

In development. Screens and video are owner-supplied captures of a recent local simulator build, not proof that the new screens are merged into current GitHub master. The Flutter client still uses legacy Firebase messaging. NestJS REST and PostgreSQL are implemented separately; Socket.IO realtime transport and custom Flutter backend integration remain pending. No public APK or production chat service is claimed.

03 / ENGINEERING

Behind the interface.

A design that feels alive

Pastel visual language and gentle illustrations are demonstrated in actual simulator captures and walkthrough clips.

Durable messaging foundations

NestJS REST API, PostgreSQL migrations, conversation membership, sender idempotency, pagination and durable read pointers.

Clear integration boundary
